rules.sentence: In ulnar neuropathy, sensory nerve action potentials (SNAP) are affected as the lesion is distal to the dorsal root ganglion, whereas, in C8 radiculopathy, SNAPs are unaffected as the lesion is proximal to the dorsal root ganglion.
In ulnar neuropathy, the amplitude of the ulnar nerve and dorsal ulnar cutaneous SNAP is decreased.
